newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EVEA PANK NOT TO PAY DIVIDENDS.
newsitem.headline: EVEA PANK NOT TO PAY DIVIDENDS.

text.p: EVEA Pank shareholders' meeting accepted a board proposal not to pay a dividend to shareholders this year, the bank said on Thursday.
The meeting decided to transfer the 1996 profit of 10 million kroons to the bank's reserve and not pay a dividend, the bank said in a statement.
The meeting also approved a decision which will allow shareholders with over 15 percent of the company's shares to have a representative on the bank's board, the statement added.
EVEA Pank is listed on the secondary list of the Tallinn stock exchange.
